metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the bill, the first playing, eleven lines, seven pound eleven shillings, and the news at supper.

yesterday: The yard went out quiet. Margery said they will come again to see if it does it twice.
The boxes held seven pound eleven. The watchet is still fifty shillings owed. Edith's eight shillings are still owed.
At supper you heard of a trial at Westminster. You asked when it was to be. The answer was tomorrow.
